name: RB Leipzig

identity.playing_style: Red Bull DNA: vertical, transition-heavy football with aggressive counter-pressing and young athletic profiles. Ole Werner (2025/26, sacked June 2026 despite 3rd place, 1.95 pts/game) rebuilt after losing key players and had no European football to manage. Demichelis, appointed within five days of Werner's exit, brings a more possession-oriented positional game from his River Plate title-winning side.
principles: Red Bull multi-club network (Salzburg, New York, Bragantino)
coach must fit the system, not vice versa
identity.club_character: Corporate-backed club founded 2009; small but growing fan base; low fan pressure but high boardroom expectations; polarising in German football culture because of the 50+1 workaround.
identity.ownership: Red Bull GmbH (corporate); voting membership restricted, widely described as a 50+1 workaround
identity.political_and_social_context: Publicly documented: long-running hostility from other German fan groups and legal/regulatory scrutiny of RB's compliance with the DFL 50+1 rule; UEFA multi-club-ownership conditions applied to Red Bull clubs entering the same competition; Jürgen Klopp's role as Red Bull Head of Global Soccer (since 2025) drew public criticism in Germany. No further institution-level controversies verified for 2025/26.
identity.wage_structure: hierarchical within a strict Red Bull wage ceiling; refuses to match Bayern/Dortmund top salaries
identity.transfer_policy: buy young, sell at peak: Yan Diomandé sold to Real Madrid for up to EUR 140m incl. bonuses (club record) in summer 2026; Maxime Estève bought from Burnley for EUR 25m; seven new signings reported after Werner's departure

last_season_2025_26.ucl_result: Did not play in Europe in 2025/26 (finished 7th in 2024/25)

strengths: Third in the Bundesliga with 1.95 pts/game under Werner despite a full rebuild.
Financial firepower from the Diomandé sale (up to EUR 140m) and Red Bull backing.
Baumgartner (13 league / 17 total goals) provides goals from midfield.
Deep young talent pipeline via the Red Bull network.
weaknesses: Coaching discontinuity: third head coach in three seasons; Demichelis has no Bundesliga or Champions League experience.
Loss of Diomandé removes the main wide creative outlet; replacements' quality unverified.
Loan returnees (Openda, Elmas, Geertruida) were surplus a year ago and their integration is uncertain.
No European football in 2025/26 means the squad has no recent experience of the midweek/weekend rhythm.

positional_needs.reason: Yan Diomandé sold to Real Madrid
Openda's return from Juventus loan is the only verified striker movement

positional_needs.profile: ball-winning 6 who can build from deep in a possession system
positional_needs.reason: Demichelis' positional style places heavier build-up demands on the pivot

Ages are computed from publicly known birth dates. Verified: 3rd place (secured matchday 33), coach Demichelis (June 2026, to 2028) after Werner's sacking, UCL opponents with venues, DFB-Pokal QF, Baumgartner 13/17 goals, Diomandé sale (up to EUR 140m) and Estève purchase (EUR 25m), loan returns of Elmas/Openda/Geertruida. NOT verified: final points, W/D/L, goals for/against (a 40-pt/5th-place snippet found was a mid-season table and was discarded), the other reported new signings, Demichelis' formation, top assister.
